# Bookkeeping Submissions

Manage bookkeeping submissions for expense documents in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::bookkeepingSubmissions()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Expenses\BookkeepingSubmissions` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `bookkeepingSubmissions.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `subject` | REQUIRED: Filter by financial document (id and type) |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `STATUSES` | `sending`, `confirmed`, `failed` |
| `SUBJECT_TYPES` | `incomingInvoice`, `incomingCreditNote`, `receipt` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List bookkeeping submissions for a specific financial document

Note: The subject filter (document id and type) is REQUIRED by the API

- `$filters` — Filters to apply (must include subject with id and type)
- `$options` — Additional options (not used for this endpoint)

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When subject filter is missing or invalid

### `forDocument()`

```php
forDocument(string $documentId, string $documentType): array
```

Get bookkeeping submissions for a specific financial document

- `$documentId` — UUID of the financial document
- `$documentType` — incomingInvoice, incomingCreditNote or receipt

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When document type is invalid

### `forInvoice()`

```php
forInvoice(string $invoiceId): array
```

Get bookkeeping submissions for an incoming invoice

- `$invoiceId` — UUID of the incoming invoice

### `forCreditNote()`

```php
forCreditNote(string $creditNoteId): array
```

Get bookkeeping submissions for an incoming credit note

- `$creditNoteId` — UUID of the incoming credit note

### `forReceipt()`

```php
forReceipt(string $receiptId): array
```

Get bookkeeping submissions for a receipt

- `$receiptId` — UUID of the receipt

### `byStatus()`

```php

```

Filter submissions by status

- `$documentId` — UUID of the financial document
- `$documentType` — Type of document
- `$status` — Status to filter by: sending, confirmed, or failed

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When status is invalid

## Examples

Get all bookkeeping submissions for a specific document:

```php
$submissions = Teamleader::bookkeepingSubmissions()->forDocument("document-uuid", "incomingInvoice");
```

Get submissions for an incoming invoice:

```php
$submissions = Teamleader::bookkeepingSubmissions()->forInvoice("invoice-uuid");
```

Get submissions for an incoming credit note:

```php
$submissions = Teamleader::bookkeepingSubmissions()->forCreditNote("credit-note-uuid");
```

Get submissions for a receipt:

```php
$submissions = Teamleader::bookkeepingSubmissions()->forReceipt("receipt-uuid");
```
